# Generated by tools/build_soul_treasures.py.
# Store a treasure of $AP$ in the first empty slot; with none free, sell it for a tenth of its AP in gold.
ac_gain_soul_treasure_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_1 } } set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_1 value = $AP$ } custom_tooltip = ac_soul_treasure_gained_tt }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_2 } } set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_2 value = $AP$ } custom_tooltip = ac_soul_treasure_gained_tt }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_3 } } set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_3 value = $AP$ } custom_tooltip = ac_soul_treasure_gained_tt }
	else = { add_gold = { value = $AP$ divide = 10 } custom_tooltip = ac_soul_treasure_sold_tt }
}
ac_refine_soul_treasure_1_effect = {
	ac_init_aura_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ac_alchemy_rank >= 4 }
		custom_tooltip = ac_elixir_ignores_limits_tt
		change_variable = { name = ac_aura_pressure add = ac_soul_treasure_1_elixir }
	}
	else = {
		custom_tooltip = ac_elixir_limited_tt
		change_variable = { name = ac_aura_pressure add = { value = ac_soul_treasure_1_elixir multiply = ac_mortal_limit_factor round = yes min = 1 } }
	}
	remove_variable = ac_soul_treasure_1
}
ac_refine_soul_treasure_2_effect = {
	ac_init_aura_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { ac_alchemy_rank >= 4 }
		custom_tooltip = ac_elixir_ignores_limits_tt

		change_variable = { name = ac_aura_pressure add = { value = ac_soul_treasure_2_elixir multiply = ac_mortal_limit_factor round = yes min = 1 } }
	}
	remove_variable = ac_soul_treasure_2
}
ac_refine_soul_treasure_3_effect = {

	if = {
		limit = { ac_alchemy_rank >= 4 }
		custom_tooltip = ac_elixir_ignores_limits_tt

# AI: hunt a beast it is likely to beat, then refine every treasure it holds.
ac_ai_hunt_spirit_beast_effect = {
	random_list = {
		0 = { modifier = { add = ac_beast_sabretooth_chance factor = 0.5 } modifier = { factor = 0 ac_beast_sabretooth_chance < 50 }
			random_list = {
				0 = { modifier = { add = ac_beast_sabretooth_chance } ac_gain_soul_treasure_effect = { AP = ac_beast_sabretooth_ap } }
